title: CausalGate
description: OPTIONAL EXTENSION — not part of the three-object ontological core. A non-authoritative analytical artifact connecting compatible community revisions through one or more supporting relations. A gate MUST be excluded if its supporting relations or its source/target community revisions are incompatible with the requested projection.

supportingRelationIds.description: Relations that support the gate. The gate is excluded if any is incompatible with the projection.

direction.description: Optional direction descriptor for the gate.

confidence.description: Optional confidence of the analytical assertion.
